question: Every 5 months, Hal has to replace the batteries in his calculator. He changed them the first time in May. In what month will they be changed the 25th time?
solution:
From the first change to the 25th there are 25 − 1 = 24 intervals. At 5 months per interval, the elapsed time is 24 × 5 = 120 months, exactly 10 years. The month is therefore the same as for the first change.
Final answer: \text{May}
